# Coverage check

*2026-10-22 · Hide & Sneak 0.11.0 · Agent Mode, default packs · generated by `node tests/coverage.js`*

**44 of 44 seeded sensitive items protected (100%).** Target for 1.0: 90% or more, with every miss listed. **False positives: 0 of 22** ordinary items that must stay visible or fillable were hidden or locked.

The three demos are fictional pages built to look like real ones: [job application](https://williamchen-pm.github.io/hide-and-sneak/demo/job-application.html), [checkout](https://williamchen-pm.github.io/hide-and-sneak/demo/checkout.html), [inbox](https://williamchen-pm.github.io/hide-and-sneak/demo/inbox.html). Each item is checked in the page text, labels, link targets, tab title, and form fields after the extension runs.
